align_bpe_to_words: align GPT-2 BPE tokens to spaCy word tokens using a RoBERTa instance
align_features_to_words: align RoBERTa BPE-level features to word-level features using a computed token alignment
spacy_nlp: get a lazy-initialized spaCy English NLP pipeline instance for tokenization
spacy_tokenizer: get a lazy-initialized spaCy tokenizer from the English NLP pipeline
review_alignment_utils: review the RoBERTa alignment utilities for BPE-to-word token and feature alignment
